result: 12-1 momentum, 6-1 momentum and trend quality pass the preliminary development/validation rule; all remain research-only

public feed is not a licensed institutional backtest dataset

result: No factor meets the current higher-weight rule over the full development and validation test; the apparent recent strength of momentum and trend does not remain strong enough over the full sample

change: Test bottom Doji and bottom bullish engulfing within zero to four bars before a daily MACD bullish cross

specification.universe: Signal-date long-term trend passes: close at least 90% of EMA200 and EMA200 60-day decline no worse than 3%
specification.bottom: Candle body top lies in lower 30% of the trailing 60-day high-low range
specification.doji: Body is no more than 10% of candle range
specification.bullish_engulfing: Bull candle opens at or below prior bear close and closes at or above prior bear open

result: Neither candle factor validated. Bottom Doji win-rate deltas were +1.0, -2.5 and +6.3 percentage points; bottom bullish engulfing deltas were +0.7, -0.4 and +7.1 across development, 2025 validation and 2026 forward observation.
known_limitations: listing identity remains unmatched for part of cache
no fees or historical quote-level slippage

change: Establish the fixed baseline for the ten-experiment rollout: signal-date long-term trend passes and daily MACD bullish cross, next-adjusted-open entry, evaluated at 20 and 100 trading days
coverage: 2,518 eligible histories; 2000-01-03 through 2026-08-21; active, delisted and unmatched-status histories retained

specification.trend_gate: close at least 90% of EMA200 and EMA200 60-day decline no worse than 3%

result: At 20 days, win rates were 55.9%, 53.5% and 53.5%; trimmed mean returns were 0.83%, 1.15% and 1.46%. At 100 days, win rates were 60.3%, 62.2% and 63.3%; trimmed mean returns were 4.02%, 8.88% and 11.71%. The 20-day edge is modest. The higher 100-day raw win rate comes with mean adverse excursions of -12.86%, -14.68% and -15.68% and is partly exposed to long-run market drift.
known_limitations: 2,138 cached histories still lack reliable active/delisted identity matching
no fees or historical quote-level slippage
raw 100-day win rate is influenced by long-run equity-market drift

change: Test whether a point-in-time daily-close congestion area adds value to the fixed long-trend plus daily-MACD-cross baseline
coverage: 2,518 eligible histories; 2000-01-03 through 2026-08-21; active, delisted and unmatched-status histories retained

specification.minimum_pullback: current close at least 5% below prior 60-day high

result: Did not validate. At 20 days, win-rate deltas versus baseline were +1.0, -1.0 and +0.9 percentage points; trimmed-return deltas were +0.23, -0.54 and -0.21. At 100 days, win-rate deltas were 0.0, -2.5 and -2.0. Price congestion alone is not promoted to tracker weight.
known_limitations: close-density is a simplified proxy for visual candle congestion
volume profile is deliberately excluded and will be tested separately
no fees or historical quote-level slippage

change: Move the long-trend and K-line-congestion comparison from daily MACD crosses to completed weekly and monthly bullish MACD crosses, with one-to-six-month holding windows
coverage: 2,518 eligible histories; 2000-01-03 through 2026-08-21; 48,859 weekly and 10,993 monthly cross events before factor filtering

specification.signal: weekly or monthly MACD bullish cross confirmed only after the full period closes
comparisons: signal-date long trend plus cross plus daily-close congestion

result: Monthly crosses were materially more consistent at longer horizons than weekly crosses. Six-month raw win rates were 64.5%, 68.1% and 70.3% for monthly crosses versus 59.6%, 60.9% and 56.2% for weekly crosses. The long-trend gate changed monthly six-month win rates by only +0.4, +0.6 and -0.4 percentage points. K-line congestion did not validate as an add-on: monthly six-month deltas versus the long-trend monthly baseline were -0.3, -10.5 and -41.3 points, with only seven completed 2026 congestion samples at six months; weekly deltas were -1.1, -3.0 and +3.5 points.
known_limitations: weekly and monthly events overlap across holding windows
raw long-horizon win rates include equity-market drift
the 2026 six-month congestion subset is incomplete and too small
no fees or historical quote-level slippage
